note: entry(i) = SHA-256('entry-<i>'), standing in for a receipt hash. leaf = SHA-256(0x00 || entry), internal node = SHA-256(0x01 || left || right), and a tree of n entries splits at the largest power of two below n. proofs[i] is the RFC 6962 audit path for entry i: sibling hashes from the leaf upwards, with no side markers, because the sides follow from the index and the size.
